native.nbi_edition: Actual reviewed Release18 source set; older or other editions require an independent schema.
native.nbi_rat: Actual terrestrial E-UTRA radio band versus independently qualified NR/NTN. No NTN fallback.
native.nbi_category: Actual combined UL/DL category; NB2 also advertises NB1, not arbitrary mixed pairs.
native.nbi_role: Actual UE versus serving base station; UE RF limits do not define eNodeB output.
native.nbi_direction: Actual scheduled direction with its own grants, blocks and repetitions.
native.nbi_deployment: Actual standalone, guardband or inband PCI relation, not an industry template.
native.nbi_duplex: Actual serving-band FDD with typeB half duplex, or TDD. Full FDD is not NB1/NB2.
native.nbi_channel: Actual NPUSCH data or uplink control, or NPDSCH unicast; other services need separate grant rules.
native.nbi_grant_kind: Actual reviewed DCI allocation versus independently qualified PUR/EDT/SIB/multiTB.
native.nbi_modulation: Actual grant-selected modulation and optional NB2 capability.
native.nbi_ns: Actual network-signalled NS_04/06 has US band edge rules; no regulatory permission from band eligibility.
native.nbi_power_class: Actual commissioned UE power class; nominal maximum not current radiated output.
native.nbi_nas_mode: Actual NB-S1 EPS versus independently registered NB-N1/other core procedures.
native.nbi_ciot_path: Actual accepted CP, UP or registered data path. CP can carry IP, non-IP or Ethernet; not automatically UDP.
native.nbi_pdn_type: Actual negotiated PDN data type, separate from radio PHY.
native.nbi_core_endpoint: Actual SCEF non-IP versus SGi binding or other independently registered core endpoint.
native.nbi_rrc_state: Actual RRC idle/connected state for power saving and data transfer.
native.nbi_emm_state: Actual normal registered service versus other NAS state.
native.nbi_timer_receiver: Actual NETWORK interpretation of request versus UE interpretation of received grant; long units differ.
native.nbi_nas_procedure_class: Actual applicable EMM/ESM timer table class; additions are not application timeout defaults.
native.nbi_revision: Actual device/firmware/network edition and compatible radio, MAC/RLC/RRC/NAS version references.
native.nbi_registered_source: Actual independent schema for another edition/RAT/category/grant/service; no assumed NR/NTN timing.
native.nbi_device_source: Actual supported band/category/multi-tone/HARQ/optional QAM and certified device capability.
native.nbi_binding_source: Actual canonical UE/cell and explicit independently registered upper/core/backhaul binding.
native.nbi_network_source: Actual serving-cell deployment, admission and resource configuration.
native.nbi_regulatory_source: Actual jurisdiction, approved spectrum and deployment permission, not universal frequencies.
native.nbi_physical_source: Actual RF link budget, antenna, receiver, interference, thermal and spectral evidence.
native.nbi_power_source: Actual band/power/MPR/A-MPR/tolerance and test conditions; band88 absent from selected class table.
native.nbi_band_qualification_source: Actual band footnote/special regional restriction qualification, including24/65/66/70/74.
native.nbi_grant_source: Actual DCI/RAR subcarrier/resource/TBS/repetition and search-space context, not invented allocation.
native.nbi_airtime_source: Actual coded/repeated resource mapping including postponements, guards and control overhead.
native.nbi_mac_rlc_source: Actual MAC/RLC/PDCP segmentation, retry, queues and complete protocol resources.
native.nbi_nas_source: Actual accepted attach/TAU core context, PSM/eDRX and protected signalling evidence.
native.nbi_application_source: Actual application codec/segmentation and functional endpoints, separate from radio TBS.
native.nbi_security_source: Actual protected subscription references, AS/NAS and independently protected application path.
native.nbi_capacity_source: Actual complete radio/core/backhaul/server capacity evidence; category peaks are not service rate.
native.nbi_acceptance_source: Actual E2E/freshness/safety acceptance, distinct from radio or NAS acknowledgements.
native.nbi_ue_ref: Actual commissioned UE reference; no fabricated IMSI/IMEI/keys or default subscriber.
native.nbi_cell_ref: Actual network-assigned serving cell reference, not default CAN identity.
native.nbi_subscription_key_ref: Actual protected credential reference, never key contents or a default credential.
native.nbi_frequency_error_source: Actual relative eNodeB carrier measurement and72/tone-slot averaging, not oscillator catalog ppm.
native.nbi_tdd_source: Actual TS36.211/331 UL/DL/special-subframe/guard configuration and eligible carrier.
native.nbi_timer_source: Actual requested/received raw NAS IE, receiver, presence, protection and latest negotiation.
native.nbi_reachability_source: Actual paging occasions/PTW/PSM/core buffering and complete downlink delivery bound.
native.nbi_band: Actual eligible terrestrial E-UTRA band; NR n-bands need their own qualified schema.
native.nbi_carrier_mhz: Actual direction-dependent radio carrier, qualified by band/NS and footnotes.
native.nbi_channel_khz: Normative NB1/NB2 channel200kHz, not the180kHz grid or useful throughput.
native.nbi_grid_khz: Normative180kHz transmission grid, separate from serving channel200kHz.
native.nbi_grid_tones: Normative grid48 at3.75kHz or12 at15kHz, not allocated tones.
native.nbi_tones: Actual contiguous allocated tones1/3/6/12;3.75kHz supports onlysingle-tone.
native.nbi_tone_index: Actual DCI subcarrier indication;3.75kHz0..47,15kHz0..18, remaining reserved.
native.nbi_first_tone: Actual first tone in the contiguous DCI allocation, not a global channel number.
native.nbi_slot_ms: Normative UL slot2ms at3.75kHz or0.5ms at15kHz.
native.nbi_symbols_per_slot: Normative seven SC-FDMA symbols in selected NPUSCH resource unit.
native.nbi_ru_slots: Normative selected NPUSCH RU16/8/4/2slots, not application cycle.
native.nbi_ru_ms: Nominal occupied selected RUslots*slot duration; guards/postponements not included.
native.nbi_ru_index: Actual DCI resource assignment index0..7 mapping1/2/3/4/5/6/8/10RUs.
native.nbi_ru_count: Actual granted RUcount, not alwaysone nor 7 forindex7.
native.nbi_rep_index: Actual NPUSCH DCI repetition index0..7 or NPDSCH0..15, not retry limit.
native.nbi_repetitions: Actual granted transmission repetitions; ULDCI1..128, DL separatelyqualified.
native.nbi_tbs_index: Actual modulation-dependent TBS index, distinct from MCS and application bytes.
native.nbi_mcs_index: Actual DCI MCS, single-tone0..10 table or multi-tone/DCI special16QAM context.
native.nbi_qam16_index: Actual DCI MCSfor16QAM index with deployment-specific TBS offset.
native.nbi_sf_index: Actual NPDSCH resource assignment index0..7; no SIB1table fallback.
native.nbi_sf_count: Actual NPDSCH1/2/3/4/5/6/8/10subframes per repetition, not an application cycle.
native.nbi_tb_bits: Actual selected grant transport block bits; not application payload or uncoded throughput.
native.nbi_dl_tb_cap_bits: Normative selected category/optional DL16QAM capability bound; not installed grant.
native.nbi_ul_tb_cap_bits: Normative selected category UL1000/2536bits; not arbitrary bytes or peakrate.
native.nbi_soft_channel_bits: Normative category DL soft channel buffer, not free application RAM.
native.nbi_layer2_cap_bytes: Normative category4000/8000/12000byte L2capability, not assigned application queue.
native.nbi_harq_processes: Actual configured one or two HARQ processes, optionalNB2capability separate.
native.nbi_hd_guard_before_ms: TypeB half-duplex receive-to-transmit guard, not deadline.
native.nbi_hd_guard_after_ms: TypeB half-duplex transmit-to-receive guard, not deadline.
native.nbi_tdd_assignment: Actual eligible TDD UL/DL configuration for chosen ULspacing.
native.nbi_functional_bound_ms: Actual functional complete E2Edeadline, separate from radio ACK.
native.nbi_nominal_max_power_dbm: Normative selected class nominal maximum23/20/14dBm, not actual output.
native.nbi_output_power_dbm: Actual measured radiated/transmitted output with MPR/tolerance/source.
native.nbi_frequency_average_slots: Normative72/allocatedtone averaging count for actual frequency error.
native.nbi_packet_bytes: Actual encoded upper-layer bytes inclactualheader; may spanmultiple radio TBs.
native.nbi_header_bytes: Actual upper-layer/security codec overhead; no universal IP/UDP/Ethernetheader.
native.nbi_nas_base_timer_s: Actual applicable named NAS procedure timer from its own table.
native.nbi_nas_timer_s: Actual applicable EMMbase+240s or ESMbase+180s inNB-S1, not application default.
native.nbi_t3412_raw: Actual GPRStimer3 octet unit/high3,value/low5, not an arbitrary lifetime.
native.nbi_t3412_value: Actual T3412 timer multiplier0..31, separate from unit and IE presence.
native.nbi_t3412_seconds: Decoded actual accepted T3412 extension;unit6 receiver/protection dependent.
native.nbi_t3324_raw: Actual GPRStimer2 octet, unit high3 and value low5.
native.nbi_t3324_value: Actual T3324 multiplier0..31;zero can mean immediatePSM, not missing.
native.nbi_t3324_seconds: Decoded actual active timer;deactivatedunit7 has no finite seconds.
native.nbi_edrx_raw: Actual octet PTWhigh4,eDRXlow4 forNB-S1, not LTE-Mtable.
native.nbi_edrx_seconds: Decoded actual effective NB-S1 eDRX cycle20.48..10485.76s.
native.nbi_ptw_seconds: Decoded actual NB-S1 PTW2.56..40.96s, not LTE-M1.28step.
native.nbi_multi_tone_supported: Actual multiTone-r13 capability; mandatoryselectedRelease18, not assumedforotherrelease.
native.nbi_multi_carrier_supported: Actual multiCarrier-r13 capability; doesnotdoubleUEresourceblock or implyaggregation.
native.nbi_ul_16qam_supported: Actual optional band-qualified npusch-16QAM-r17 NB2unicast capability.
native.nbi_cp_supported: Actual NB-S1 UE/network mandatoryCP CIoTsupport, not choiceofactualservicepath.
native.nbi_s1u_supported: Actual S1-Udata-transfer capability, independently from CPoptimizeddelivery.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded application bytes may spanmultiple MAC/RLC/PDCP blocks. No universal8/1500byte packet, applicationrate250k or directpayload/TBS ratio. Actualheader andsegmentation sourceindependent.
